user_message: Where is my frontend hosted, and what is the current SSL status?

context.content: The frontend is hosted on Vercel with a custom domain. SSL was previously enabled, but the user later said the SSL setup would change without supplying the replacement state. Cloudflare currently manages DNS. The application API runs in Docker behind Nginx. SQLite is the canonical source of truth and Chroma stores rebuildable vector pointers. A slow-path worker extracts atomic facts, reconciles foresight, updates the typed graph, and promotes durable memory. The user prefers provider-independent model configuration and currently uses DeepSeek for inference. Local FastEmbed generates 384-dimensional vectors with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5. The MCP server is deployed as a separate authenticated service. GitHub OAuth owns normal user sessions, while the demo workspace remains isolated and disposable. Conversation deletion removes provenance and disables unsupported derived memory. Retrieval is selected in two stages: context scope first, then quick, deep, or relational durable retrieval when required. The answer trace records retrieved facts, session items, graph paths, sufficiency, and prompt sections. Foresight records have validity windows and can become resolved, expired, or cancelled. Reflections require evidence and are generated by gated slow-path batches rather than every single turn. Communities are graph-derived summaries used as deep retrieval context. NetworkX and igraph are read-only algorithm views; neither replaces SQLite persistence. The current configuration does not state which managed database service would be used if SQLite were replaced, and no disaster-recovery region has been selected.
Be precise about unknown values and do not infer a replacement SSL state.
